records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve pixel sprite edit. Edit target and exact identity/style: image 1, the original fox swordswoman on green. Image 2 is ONLY a rough pose guide for a horizontal-cut finishing pose; do not copy its missing arm, shortened blade or side-view body. Create ONE full-body endpoint sprite of the SAME character from image 1 after a waist-height horizontal cut toward screen-RIGHT. Same coarse original pixel scale and large connected color clusters; do not redraw as detailed art. Preserve exactly the golden hair and single side ponytail, amber eyes, small mouth, fox ears, yellow cape, fully covered cream long sleeves and tunic, brown belt/leggings, gold boots and ONE cream-tipped tail. SAME 4:3 canvas, original sprite scale, feet around y=690 on a 1024x768 layout, head around y=365. Stable shallow THREE-QUARTER body view like image 1, looking right. Chest clasp and front belt buckle BOTH remain visible and point the same direction; ribs stay stacked naturally over the pelvis, shoulders and hips aligned, only a tiny coordinated turn. Do not twist or narrow the waist, turn her back, or rotate shoulders opposite the hips. Maintain original foot spacing with a SMALL front-knee bend and slight forward weight transfer, no long lunge, no crossed legs, no foot swap. After the cut BOTH elbows remain slightly bent, not locked. Draw TWO clearly connected covered forearms and TWO hands wrapped around the SAME brown handle, hands spaced along that handle BEHIND the gold straight crossguard. Hands never touch steel. The same ONE rigid straight gray-blue greatsword now lies HORIZONTAL toward screen-RIGHT at lower-chest/waist height: hilt about x=565 to630,y=500; gold guard near (650,500); single steel blade extends to tip near (890,500), around 240 pixels long and 36 pixels wide with pale edges and center ridge. The two arms, hands and hilt must make one anatomically coherent held object. Sword stays its original physical dimensions, no thin short dagger, extra blade or motion duplicate. The body pose should look balanced and natural, with force transferred through the front leg, not wrung through the waist. Front of outfit remains clearly visible, pouch stays on the original visible right hip. Entire body and entire blade inside canvas. Exact same plain flat bright green background as image 1. No glow, no white arcs, particles, trails, blur, dust, shadows, labels or panels. ONE sprite only.
